# Wei Chen — Director, Clinical Informatics (Epic Program Director)

- **Relationship:** Diane's direct report; leads the Epic program and clinical informatics.
- **Cadence:** weekly 1:1; daily during stabilization.
- **What he owns:** [Epic EHR Go-Live — Phase 1](../projects/epic-golive-phase-1.md) **and**
  [Epic Optimization — Phase 2](../projects/epic-optimization-phase-2.md). The **bed-management /
  capacity module** that ED throughput depends on is a **Phase 2** deliverable Wei owns.

## How to work with him
- Translate Epic issues into operational/patient-safety terms for Diane (she is non-technical);
  Wei is good at this — lean on him for plain-language readouts.
- Owns the command-center demobilization decision (target ~2026-08-01).

## Sensitivities
- Team is burned out post-go-live; watch for attrition among the analyst team.
